The second diagram shows the same 11 cards rearranged, with only the top letters visible: P, S, I, S, I, M, I, S, S, P, I. Reasoning: Group the possible bottom letters by the top letter from the first diagram: M has K; P has A and R; S has L, I, A, N; I has I, M, J, O. For the second diagram top row P S I S I M I S S P I, choose unused matching bottom letters from these groups. One valid assignment is P→A, S→N, I→M, S→A, I→I, M→K, I→O, S→L, S→I, P→R, I→J. This gives the bottom sequence ANMAIKOLIRJ.
